payload.name: Spatial Contiguity Principle
payload.fact: Students learn better when visual and verbal materials are physically close rather than far apart.

provenance.title: Cognitive principles of multimedia learning: The role of modality and contiguity.
provenance.quote_or_locus: Experiment 1 revealed a spatial-contiguity effect in which students learned better when visual and verbal materials were physically close
